More Info More Info Opens in a new window Kate HarpringPosition(s)GuardHeight5‐11Age18HometownAtlanta, GAHigh SchoolMarist SchoolCollegeUniversity of North Carolina (Commit)BioFiba 5x5As of April 15, 2026 USA Basketball Notes Gold Medals: 2025 FIBA U19 World Cup. Teams: 2026 USA Women's Nike Hoop Summit Team, 2025 USA Women's U19 National Team. 2026: Named to the 2026 USA Women's Nike Hoop Summit Team (1/9/26), but did not particpate due to injury. 2025: Won a gold medal at the 2025 FIBA U19 World Cup in Brno, Czechia. In 7 games, averaged 8.3 points, 3.7 rebounds, 2.4 assists and 16:03 minutes as the USA went 7-0. Three games with 13+ points, including 15 points (7-12 FG, 1-2 3FG), 6 rebounds and 7 assists in 19 minutes vs. CHN (7/16/25). Named to the 2025 USA Women's U19 National Team after three days of trials in Colorado Springs, CO (6/20/25). Attended the 2025 Women's Junior National Team April minicamp in Tampa. 2024: Named as a finalist for the 2024 USA Women's U17 National Team (5/25/24) after participating in trials in Colorado Springs, CO.
